apollo: Duels with the blade and perfect timing

Apollo lives and dies by timing: a clean Riposte or a perfectly held Flawless Advance can turn a duel before it starts. When the moment is right, Itani Lo Sahn freezes his foes in slow motion so he can finish what he started.
billy: Smashes in and drags everyone down with him

Billy doesn't wait for a fight, he starts one, ramming enemies into the air and slamming them back to the ground. Every melee hit reloads his gun, and Chain Gang makes sure no one gets to leave early.
celeste: Dazzles foes with blinding bursts of light

Celeste shines brightest in the middle of a skirmish, marking enemies with Light Eater and punishing anyone who breaks her prism. Each Radiant Daggers hit on a hero makes her stronger, so a well-placed beam early pays off all fight long.
drifter: Hunts down the isolated and the lost

Drifter follows the scent of blood to enemies who wander too far from their team, then appears behind them with Stalker's Mark. Eternal Night plunges a whole group into darkness, leaving every victim alone with him.
graves: Raises the dead to hold the line

Graves turns every death on the battlefield into another servant, filling lanes with Ghouls and Deadheads that wear enemies down. Grasping Hands walls off approaches, while Essence Theft drains the strength of anyone foolish enough to trade shots with her.
mina: Bleeds foes dry and slips away on bat wings

Mina chips away at enemies with Love Bites, building to a vicious burst before finishing the wounded with Rake. When a fight turns sour, Sanguine Retreat whisks her away untouchable, and Nox Nostra's swarm grows deadlier every time she feeds.
paige: Writes her allies a happy ending

Paige protects her friends from a safe distance, shielding them with Plot Armor and pinning enemies in place with Captivating Read. Rallying Charge sends her spectral knights across the entire city, turning distant fights in her team's favor.
rem: Naps on allies and puts enemies to sleep

Rem keeps his team rested and ready, hopping between allies with Tag Along to heal them while his Lil Helpers lend a hand across the map. Naptime locks enemies in place and sends them to sleep, and they wake up to a splitting headache.
silver: Unleashes the beast when the fight gets bloody

Silver is a steady long-range shooter who ties down targets with her bola and kicks them away when they get too close. As the damage piles up her bloodlust takes over, transforming her into a ferocious Lycan that tears through anyone left standing.
doorman: Checks enemies out and reroutes the fight

The Doorman controls where the battle happens, opening Doorways across the map and hauling enemies out of position with his Luggage Cart. Hotel Guest removes a key target entirely, sending them on a costly stay at the Baroness while his team finishes the job.
venator: Hunts monsters with steel, fire and faith

Venator is a methodical hunter, laying Snap Traps and burning enemies out of cover before pinning them to a wall with Gutshot. Ira Domini loads three blessed stakes that hit like a freight train, executing any prey left clinging to life.
victor: Turns pain into power and refuses to die

Victor thrives on the damage he takes, charging his Pain Battery and hurting himself to move faster and heal harder. Even death is only a setback: Shocking Reanimation brings him back to his feet, stunning everyone who thought the fight was over.
ratking: Leads the charge under the royal banner

The Rat King leads from the front, bouncing Scrap Grenades into enemy lines and sending a Rat Swarm to chew through their bullet resist before he opens fire. Royal Pestments let him wade through focused fire and deflect bullets back at the shooter, and when the big fight comes, the banner of Ratannia makes his whole team faster, immune to slows and harder to kill.
baba: Steals spirit and hexes the unruly

Baba may look like a harmless old lady on a park bench, but Threadsap steals enemy spirit to power up her bullets, and Granny Long Legs turns her bench into a kicking, stomping brawler. Time Baba's Brew to land the right blend of barrier, silence or burn, then finish the fight with Feed The Birds, turning anyone covered in bread into a pigeon.
solomon: Plays the battlefield like a chessboard

Solomon treats every fight like a game of chess, sliding Bishops through enemies to slow them and sending Rook Battery down a lane to lock them in place. Kingside Knight shields an ally and moves them out of danger, and when the board is set, Develop Queen crashes down to stun everyone caught in her lines.
danny: Rockets in from above to blow foes away

Deadman Danny takes to the skies with the Chimera Mk1, firing rockets from above and laying Strix Salvo minefields that mark enemies for his charged shots. When the jetpack overheats he dives into the crowd for an explosive landing, and Close The Deal grabs a single victim for a sky-high demonstration that ends with both of them hitting the pavement.
violet: Turns the battlefield into her canvas

Violet steers her empowered bullets with Living Ink, cutting her cooldowns with every hit, or draws walls of ink to block enemies in their tracks. Flow State lets her team slide around the fight while slowing anyone in her path, Still Life stuns her subject and keeps their sketch as a permanent trophy, and Abstract Landscape punishes anyone who tries to leave her masterpiece.
harrow: Heals allies and terrifies her enemies

Nurse Harrow keeps her team in the fight with Healing Needles fired straight from her gun, while every jar of Leech Therapy drains enemy buffs before the leeches crawl back to make her stronger. Wretched Vapors push an ally into a reckless rush at the cost of a crash later, and Lurking Terrors locks down anyone who dares to look at her until they flee in fear.
